## How secure is Karbon AI?

Your data remains secure in Karbon when incorporating Karbon AI

- Oct 14, 2025
- Knowledge

### Information

Last Modified Date

10/14/2025 9:41 PM

Summary

Help Summary

Your data remains secure in Karbon when incorporating Karbon AI

Article Body

The Microsoft Azure OpenAI Service, which powers Karbon AI,
provides critical enterprise security, compliance, and regional
availability.

Your data is always secure and stays within Karbon, alongside all
your other data.

When artificial intelligence is in the context of your workflow,
it can be prompted by your existing data without relinquishing
security.
